scope: Species 1–493 (the ones PokeSwap uses today) and every Gen VI form of them.
note: Nothing from these repositories is committed to PokeSwap. The fetch step caches the listed files under node_modules/.cache (git-ignored) and the build step emits PokeSwap's own catalog from them. No flavour text, sprites or assets are read or copied.

sources.role: tabular data (species, stats, types, moves, learnsets, abilities, natures, type chart)

Generation VI correction layer and semantic reference. The tabular source ships present-day base stats and ability slots; this pinned mod is the recorded diff back to Gen VI, and the build applies its baseStats/abilities overrides. Its move data answers the one question the tabular tables cannot: who receives a stat change and with what probability. It is read as data and cross-checked against the tabular rows; no effect code is copied.
cross-check only, never at runtime and never in this pipeline.
